regions.region: full original page: title, abstract, introduction, and Scheme 1
regions.finding: The page was visually inspected. Scheme 1 is an inventory of biologically active 5,6-dihydropyran-2-one and cyclobutene structures, not a reaction scheme; the abstract gives only the paper-level transformation class. No independent experiment record was created from this page.

unresolved: The biological structures are contextual examples and were not independently structure-verified or converted into reaction participants.

regions.region: left column, prior-work prose and Scheme 2
regions.finding: Prior thermal/photochemical allenene cycloadditions, the Ohno allenyne example, prose-only Shen and Oh summaries, and the Brummond–Chen microwave example were classified as literature examples. The 2 + 1 to 16 relationship was classified as a conceptual general scheme, not a reported experiment.

regions.region: lower left, Scheme 3 and adjoining Results and discussion prose
regions.finding: Three distinct trials were identified: 16a in refluxing toluene for 24 h gave no reaction; 16b under the separate 24 h condition was complicated; 16c under 4 h gave 17c and 18c. The 16c trial was merged with Table 1 entry 1, Table 2 entry 1, and section 4.1.1 rather than duplicated.

All four solvent rows were inspected. The toluene row maps to the merged 16c record; dioxane, xylene, and DMF remain three independent optimization entries with row-specific times and isolated yields for both 17c and 18c.
The prose was used as context for Table 2 selectivity and byproduct interpretation. It was not counted as additional experiments beyond the table rows.

The Scheme 2 text '3M ionic liquid' has unresolved identity and concentration/basis and was retained textually rather than forced into a quantity field.
The 16a/16b preliminary trials omit scale, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, purification, and detection details.
Table 1 entries 2–4 omit scale, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, and purification.

regions.region: upper half, complete Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1–14, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: All fourteen substrate-scope rows were made independent except that entry 1 was merged with its repeated Scheme 3/Table 1/section 4.1.1 presentation. Isolated yields and times were preserved row by row. Footnote b was stored as chromatographic non-detection for entry 2; footnote c as unidentified products for entry 6 without converting the dash to zero; footnote d as no Diels–Alder product for entries 7–14.
The crystallographic structure assignment was linked to Table 2 entry 5/18g and was not treated as a separate synthetic experiment.

Dry toluene, reflux under argon, TLC monitoring, rotary-evaporation workup, and silica-gel chromatography were attached to the Table 2 records. Exact example-specific quantities on pages 4–6 override the nominal general-procedure scale and volume where available.

Entry 6 does not identify or quantify the other products.
For entries 13–14, pages 1–6 provide only nominal general-procedure scale/volume, not row-specific masses or isolated product masses.
Complex structures and stereochemical assignments remain unverified.
